datasets.name: ov_lgu
queryLines:
SELECT b.*, st_setsrid(st_simplify(st_geomfromgeojson(h.geometry), 0.003), 4326) AS boundary
FROM (
  WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name, d.city_class, d.income_class,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.type_plural, l.city_class, l.income_class, m.*,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS priority_sort,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 5 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 4 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 2 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 1 END AS priority_level,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.ap1_pressure_flag THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap2_pressure_flag THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None above reference') AS combo,
         CASE WHEN m.enrollment_trend_status = 'Complete' THEN m.enrollment_trend ELSE 'Trend in Data Review' END AS direction,
         CAST(m.current_pressure_count AS STRING) || ' of 3' AS pressures_label,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(m.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) AS max_rp,
         CASE WHEN m.priority = 'Data Review'
              THEN 'Data Review: ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws('; ', 'schools ' || m.ap1_quality_issue_reason,
                                                               'classrooms ' || m.ap2_quality_issue_reason,
                                                               'teachers ' || m.ap3_quality_issue_reason), ''), 'a measure is missing')
              ELSE CASE WHEN m.current_pressure_count = 0 THEN 'No pressure above reference'
                        ELSE concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.ap1_pressure_flag THEN 'Schools' END,
                                              CASE WHEN m.ap2_pressure_flag THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                              CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END) || ' above reference' END
                   || ' · ' || CASE WHEN m.enrollment_trend_status = 'Complete'
                                    THEN 'enrollment ' || lower(m.enrollment_trend) || ' ' || CASE WHEN m.enrollment_pct_change IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN m.enrollment_pct_change >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(100 * m.enrollment_pct_change, 1) AS STRING) || '%', '')
                                    ELSE 'enrollment trend in Data Review' END
                   || ' → ' || m.priority END AS why
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
)
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, current_pressure_count DESC, GREATEST(COALESCE(ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) DESC, city_mun_psgc_code) AS list_order,
         city_mun_psgc_code, lgu_label, lgu_type_label, province_label, region_name,
         priority, priority_sort, priority_level, combo, direction, pressures_label, current_pressure_count, why,
         ap1_ratio, ap1_national_same_type_ratio, ap1_relative_pressure, ap1_coverage_pct,
         ap2_ratio, ap2_national_same_type_ratio, ap2_relative_pressure, ap2_learner_coverage_pct,
         ap3_ratio, ap3_national_same_type_ratio, ap3_relative_pressure, ap3_learner_coverage_pct,
         enrollment_pct_change, enrollment_2025_26
  FROM pri
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type) AND (:prio = 'All priorities' OR priority = :prio) AND (:dir = 'All directions' OR direction = :dir) AND (:combo = 'All combinations' OR combo = :combo)
) AS b
LEFT JOIN edu_access.`04-integration`.hdx_adm3_psgc_map AS m
  ON m.psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code AND m.match_status = 'matched'
LEFT JOIN edu_access.`03-silver`.hdx_adm3_clean AS h ON h.adm3_pcode = m.adm3_pcode
ORDER BY b.list_order

),

queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name, d.city_class, d.income_class,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE p.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, p.current_pressure_count DESC, GREATEST(COALESCE(p.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) DESC, p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
e23 AS (
  SELECT * FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment WHERE school_year = '2023-24' AND sector = 'Public' AND psgc_match_status = 'matched'
),
sch AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, e.city_mun_psgc_code, MAX(e.barangay_psgc_code) AS barangay_psgc_code, MAX(e.annex_status) AS annex_status,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.learner_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_active,
         COUNT_IF(e.is_offered AND e.learner_count IS NULL) AS incomplete_levels,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.learner_count IS NOT NULL THEN e.learner_count ELSE 0 END) AS learners,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'ES' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'JHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_jhs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'SHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_shs
  FROM e23 AS e GROUP BY e.school_id, e.city_mun_psgc_code
),
typed AS (
  SELECT s.*, l.lgu_type_label, r.instructional_classrooms_total AS rooms
  FROM sch AS s
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = s.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
),
room_ratio AS (
  SELECT school_id, lgu_type_label, CAST(learners AS DOUBLE) / rooms AS ratio FROM typed
  WHERE is_active = 1 AND incomplete_levels = 0 AND rooms > 0
),
room_fence AS (
  SELECT lgu_type_label, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio) AS q1,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio) AS q3
  FROM room_ratio GROUP BY lgu_type_label
),
lvl AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, e.education_level_code, e.learner_count, t.teacher_count, t.school_id IS NOT NULL AS has_row,
         e.annex_status, l.lgu_type_label
  FROM e23 AS e
  JOIN typed AS s ON s.school_id = e.school_id AND s.is_active = 1
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = e.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_teacher_capacity AS t
    ON t.school_id = e.school_id AND t.school_year = '2023-24' AND t.education_level_code = e.education_level_code
  WHERE e.is_offered
),
teacher_fence AS (
  SELECT lgu_type_label, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(learner_count AS DOUBLE) / teacher_count) AS q1,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(learner_count AS DOUBLE) / teacher_count) AS q3
  FROM lvl WHERE learner_count IS NOT NULL AND teacher_count > 0 GROUP BY lgu_type_label
),
tsch AS (
  SELECT v.school_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 THEN v.teacher_count ELSE 0 END) AS teachers,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 AND v.learner_count IS NOT NULL THEN v.learner_count ELSE 0 END) AS learners_with_teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 AND v.learner_count IS NOT NULL
                   AND CAST(v.learner_count AS DOUBLE) / v.teacher_count > f.q3 + 3 * (f.q3 - f.q1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NOT v.has_row OR v.teacher_count IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teachers_missing,
         MAX(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count = 0 AND COALESCE(v.annex_status, '') <> 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teachers_zero
  FROM lvl AS v JOIN teacher_fence AS f ON f.lgu_type_label = v.lgu_type_label
  GROUP BY v.school_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(ds.school_name, s.school_id) AS school_name,
         COALESCE(b.barangay_name, 'Barangay not matched') AS barangay_name,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status = 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 'Annex' ELSE 'Main' END AS school_kind,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'ES' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'JHS' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'SHS' END) AS levels_offered,
         s.offers_es, s.learners, s.rooms, t.teachers,
         s.learners / NULLIF(CAST(s.rooms AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_room,
         t.learners_with_teachers / NULLIF(CAST(t.teachers AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN rr.ratio > rf.q3 + 3 * (rf.q3 - rf.q1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS room_outlier,
         COALESCE(t.teacher_outlier, 0) AS teacher_outlier,
         CASE WHEN s.rooms IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_missing,
         CASE WHEN s.rooms = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_zero,
         COALESCE(t.teachers_missing, 0) AS teachers_missing, COALESCE(t.teachers_zero, 0) AS teachers_zero
  FROM typed AS s
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = s.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code AND b.member_type = 'regular'
  LEFT JOIN room_ratio AS rr ON rr.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN room_fence AS rf ON rf.lgu_type_label = s.lgu_type_label
  LEFT JOIN tsch AS t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 OR teacher_outlier = 1 THEN 'Outlier: check the report'
              WHEN rooms_missing = 1 OR teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing data'
              WHEN rooms_zero = 1 OR teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No flag' END AS flag,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 THEN 'room outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN teacher_outlier = 1 THEN 'teacher outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'rooms not reported' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'zero rooms' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'a level with no teacher row' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'a level with zero teachers' END) AS issues
  FROM x
),
bs AS (
  SELECT barangay_name, COUNT(*) AS schools, MAX(offers_es) AS offers_es, SUM(learners) AS learners,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms, SUM(teachers) AS teachers
  FROM flagged GROUP BY barangay_name
),
br AS (
  SELECT b.barangay_name, COALESCE(b.urban_rural, 'n/a') AS urban_rural, COALESCE(bs.schools, 0) AS schools,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.offers_es, 0) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS offers_public_es,
         COALESCE(bs.learners, 0) AS learners, COALESCE(bs.rooms, 0) AS rooms, COALESCE(bs.teachers, 0) AS teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN bs ON bs.barangay_name = b.barangay_name
  WHERE b.member_type = 'regular'
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT_IF(offers_public_es = 'No') FROM br) AS barangays_without_public_es,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM br) AS regular_barangays,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(flag <> 'No flag') FROM flagged) AS schools_to_check,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flagged) AS schools_listed,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(barangay_name = 'Barangay not matched') FROM flagged) AS schools_without_barangay,
       CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT_IF(barangay_name = 'Barangay not matched') FROM flagged) > 0 THEN 'At most ' ELSE '' END AS bound_prefix

WITH lgu AS (

         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,

         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,

  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.type_plural, l.city_class, l.income_class, m.*,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS priority_sort,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 5 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 4 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 2 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 1 END AS priority_level,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.ap1_pressure_flag THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap2_pressure_flag THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None above reference') AS combo,
         CASE WHEN m.enrollment_trend_status = 'Complete' THEN m.enrollment_trend ELSE 'Trend in Data Review' END AS direction,
         CAST(m.current_pressure_count AS STRING) || ' of 3' AS pressures_label,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(m.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) AS max_rp,

                                              CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END) || ' above reference' END

WITH lgu AS (

         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE p.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, p.current_pressure_count DESC, GREATEST(COALESCE(p.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) DESC, p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
),
e23 AS (
  SELECT * FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_enrollment WHERE school_year = '2023-24' AND sector = 'Public' AND psgc_match_status = 'matched'
),
sch AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, e.city_mun_psgc_code, MAX(e.barangay_psgc_code) AS barangay_psgc_code, MAX(e.annex_status) AS annex_status,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.learner_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_active,
         COUNT_IF(e.is_offered AND e.learner_count IS NULL) AS incomplete_levels,
         SUM(CASE WHEN e.is_offered AND e.learner_count IS NOT NULL THEN e.learner_count ELSE 0 END) AS learners,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'ES' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_es,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'JHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_jhs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN e.education_level_code = 'SHS' AND e.is_offered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offers_shs
  FROM e23 AS e GROUP BY e.school_id, e.city_mun_psgc_code
),
typed AS (
  SELECT s.*, l.lgu_type_label, r.instructional_classrooms_total AS rooms
  FROM sch AS s
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = s.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_classroom_capacity AS r ON r.school_id = s.school_id AND r.school_year = '2023-24'
),
room_ratio AS (
  SELECT school_id, lgu_type_label, CAST(learners AS DOUBLE) / rooms AS ratio FROM typed
  WHERE is_active = 1 AND incomplete_levels = 0 AND rooms > 0
),
room_fence AS (
  SELECT lgu_type_label, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio) AS q1,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ratio) AS q3
  FROM room_ratio GROUP BY lgu_type_label
),
lvl AS (
  SELECT e.school_id, e.education_level_code, e.learner_count, t.teacher_count, t.school_id IS NOT NULL AS has_row,
         e.annex_status, l.lgu_type_label
  FROM e23 AS e
  JOIN typed AS s ON s.school_id = e.school_id AND s.is_active = 1
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = e.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.fact_school_teacher_capacity AS t
    ON t.school_id = e.school_id AND t.school_year = '2023-24' AND t.education_level_code = e.education_level_code
  WHERE e.is_offered
),
teacher_fence AS (
  SELECT lgu_type_label, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(learner_count AS DOUBLE) / teacher_count) AS q1,
         PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(learner_count AS DOUBLE) / teacher_count) AS q3
  FROM lvl WHERE learner_count IS NOT NULL AND teacher_count > 0 GROUP BY lgu_type_label
),
tsch AS (
  SELECT v.school_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 THEN v.teacher_count ELSE 0 END) AS teachers,
         SUM(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 AND v.learner_count IS NOT NULL THEN v.learner_count ELSE 0 END) AS learners_with_teachers,
         MAX(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count > 0 AND v.learner_count IS NOT NULL
                   AND CAST(v.learner_count AS DOUBLE) / v.teacher_count > f.q3 + 3 * (f.q3 - f.q1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teacher_outlier,
         MAX(CASE WHEN NOT v.has_row OR v.teacher_count IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teachers_missing,
         MAX(CASE WHEN v.teacher_count = 0 AND COALESCE(v.annex_status, '') <> 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS teachers_zero
  FROM lvl AS v JOIN teacher_fence AS f ON f.lgu_type_label = v.lgu_type_label
  GROUP BY v.school_id
),
x AS (
  SELECT s.school_id, COALESCE(ds.school_name, s.school_id) AS school_name,
         COALESCE(b.barangay_name, 'Barangay not matched') AS barangay_name,
         CASE WHEN s.annex_status = 'Annex/Extension School' THEN 'Annex' ELSE 'Main' END AS school_kind,
         concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN s.offers_es = 1 THEN 'ES' END, CASE WHEN s.offers_jhs = 1 THEN 'JHS' END,
                          CASE WHEN s.offers_shs = 1 THEN 'SHS' END) AS levels_offered,
         s.offers_es, s.learners, s.rooms, t.teachers,
         s.learners / NULLIF(CAST(s.rooms AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_room,
         t.learners_with_teachers / NULLIF(CAST(t.teachers AS DOUBLE), 0) AS learners_per_teacher,
         CASE WHEN rr.ratio > rf.q3 + 3 * (rf.q3 - rf.q1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS room_outlier,
         COALESCE(t.teacher_outlier, 0) AS teacher_outlier,
         CASE WHEN s.rooms IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_missing,
         CASE WHEN s.rooms = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rooms_zero,
         COALESCE(t.teachers_missing, 0) AS teachers_missing, COALESCE(t.teachers_zero, 0) AS teachers_zero
  FROM typed AS s
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = s.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_school AS ds ON ds.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b ON b.barangay_psgc_code = s.barangay_psgc_code AND b.member_type = 'regular'
  LEFT JOIN room_ratio AS rr ON rr.school_id = s.school_id
  LEFT JOIN room_fence AS rf ON rf.lgu_type_label = s.lgu_type_label
  LEFT JOIN tsch AS t ON t.school_id = s.school_id
  WHERE s.is_active = 1
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT x.*,
         CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 OR teacher_outlier = 1 THEN 'Outlier: check the report'
              WHEN rooms_missing = 1 OR teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'Missing data'
              WHEN rooms_zero = 1 OR teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'Zero rooms or teachers'
              ELSE 'No flag' END AS flag,
         concat_ws(', ', CASE WHEN room_outlier = 1 THEN 'room outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN teacher_outlier = 1 THEN 'teacher outlier' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_missing = 1 THEN 'rooms not reported' END,
                         CASE WHEN rooms_zero = 1 THEN 'zero rooms' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_missing = 1 THEN 'a level with no teacher row' END,
                         CASE WHEN teachers_zero = 1 THEN 'a level with zero teachers' END) AS issues
  FROM x
),
bs AS (
  SELECT barangay_name, COUNT(*) AS schools, MAX(offers_es) AS offers_es, SUM(learners) AS learners,
         SUM(rooms) AS rooms, SUM(teachers) AS teachers
  FROM flagged GROUP BY barangay_name
),
br AS (
  SELECT b.barangay_name, COALESCE(b.urban_rural, 'n/a') AS urban_rural, COALESCE(bs.schools, 0) AS schools,
         CASE WHEN COALESCE(bs.offers_es, 0) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS offers_public_es,
         COALESCE(bs.learners, 0) AS learners, COALESCE(bs.rooms, 0) AS rooms, COALESCE(bs.teachers, 0) AS teachers
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN bs ON bs.barangay_name = b.barangay_name
  WHERE b.member_type = 'regular'
)

       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN br.offers_public_es = 'No' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, br.learners DESC, br.barangay_name) AS brgy_order
FROM br

WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name, d.city_class, d.income_class,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
pri AS (
  SELECT l.lgu_label, l.province_label, l.lgu_type_label, l.type_plural, l.city_class, l.income_class, m.*,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS priority_sort,
         CASE m.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 5 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 4 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3
              WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 2 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 1 END AS priority_level,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.ap1_pressure_flag THEN 'Schools' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap2_pressure_flag THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                          CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END), ''), 'None above reference') AS combo,
         CASE WHEN m.enrollment_trend_status = 'Complete' THEN m.enrollment_trend ELSE 'Trend in Data Review' END AS direction,
         CAST(m.current_pressure_count AS STRING) || ' of 3' AS pressures_label,
         GREATEST(COALESCE(m.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(m.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) AS max_rp,
         CASE WHEN m.priority = 'Data Review'
              THEN 'Data Review: ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(concat_ws('; ', 'schools ' || m.ap1_quality_issue_reason,
                                                               'classrooms ' || m.ap2_quality_issue_reason,
                                                               'teachers ' || m.ap3_quality_issue_reason), ''), 'a measure is missing')
              ELSE CASE WHEN m.current_pressure_count = 0 THEN 'No pressure above reference'
                        ELSE concat_ws(' + ', CASE WHEN m.ap1_pressure_flag THEN 'Schools' END,
                                              CASE WHEN m.ap2_pressure_flag THEN 'Classrooms' END,
                                              CASE WHEN m.ap3_pressure_flag THEN 'Teachers' END) || ' above reference' END
                   || ' · ' || CASE WHEN m.enrollment_trend_status = 'Complete'
                                    THEN 'enrollment ' || lower(m.enrollment_trend) || ' ' || CASE WHEN m.enrollment_pct_change IS NULL THEN 'n/a' WHEN m.enrollment_pct_change >= 0 THEN '+' ELSE '' END || COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(100 * m.enrollment_pct_change, 1) AS STRING) || '%', '')
                                    ELSE 'enrollment trend in Data Review' END
                   || ' → ' || m.priority END AS why
  FROM edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS m
  JOIN lgu AS l ON l.city_mun_psgc_code = m.city_mun_psgc_code
),
cand AS (
  SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE p.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, p.current_pressure_count DESC, GREATEST(COALESCE(p.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) DESC, p.city_mun_psgc_code) AS rn FROM pri AS p WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
),
pick AS (
  SELECT 'A' AS slot, (SELECT city_mun_psgc_code FROM cand ORDER BY CASE WHEN lgu_label = :cmp_a THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rn LIMIT 1) AS code
  UNION ALL SELECT 'B', (SELECT city_mun_psgc_code FROM cand ORDER BY CASE WHEN lgu_label = :cmp_b THEN 0 WHEN rn = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rn LIMIT 1)
  UNION ALL SELECT 'C', (SELECT city_mun_psgc_code FROM cand ORDER BY CASE WHEN lgu_label = :cmp_c THEN 0 WHEN rn = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, rn LIMIT 1)
),
cmp AS (
  SELECT k.slot, k.slot || ' · ' || c.lgu_label AS lgu_slot, c.*
  FROM pick AS k JOIN cand AS c ON c.city_mun_psgc_code = k.code
)
SELECT slot, lgu_slot, lgu_type_label, priority, pressures_label, direction, why,
       ap1_ratio, ap1_national_same_type_ratio, ap1_relative_pressure, ap1_classification,
       ap2_ratio, ap2_national_same_type_ratio, ap2_relative_pressure, ap2_classification,
       ap3_ratio, ap3_national_same_type_ratio, ap3_relative_pressure, ap3_classification,
       enrollment_2025_26, enrollment_pct_change
FROM cmp
ORDER BY slot

queryLines:
WITH lgu AS (
  SELECT d.city_mun_psgc_code, d.city_mun_name,
         d.city_mun_name || ', ' || COALESCE(d.province_name, d.region_name) AS lgu_label,
         COALESCE(d.province_name, 'Independent cities (no province)') AS province_label,
         d.region_name, d.city_class, d.income_class,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'City' WHEN 'municipality' THEN 'Municipality' END AS lgu_type_label,
         CASE d.lgu_type WHEN 'city' THEN 'cities' ELSE 'municipalities' END AS type_plural
  FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_city_municipality AS d
  WHERE d.member_type = 'regular'
),
sel AS (
  SELECT l.city_mun_psgc_code, l.lgu_label
  FROM lgu AS l
  JOIN edu_access.`06-analytics`.lgu_priority_matrix AS p ON p.city_mun_psgc_code = l.city_mun_psgc_code
  WHERE (:region = 'All regions' OR l.region_name = :region) AND (:province = 'All provinces' OR l.province_label = :province) AND (:lgu_type = 'All LGU types' OR l.lgu_type_label = :lgu_type)
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.lgu_label = :lgu THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE p.priority WHEN 'Priority 1' THEN 1 WHEN 'Priority 2' THEN 2 WHEN 'Priority 3' THEN 3 WHEN 'Monitor' THEN 4 WHEN 'Lower Priority' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, p.current_pressure_count DESC, GREATEST(COALESCE(p.ap1_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap2_relative_pressure, 0), COALESCE(p.ap3_relative_pressure, 0)) DESC, p.city_mun_psgc_code
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT barangay_option FROM (
  SELECT 'All barangays' AS barangay_option, 0 AS s
  UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT b.barangay_name, 1 FROM edu_access.`05-gold`.dim_barangay AS b
  JOIN sel ON sel.city_mun_psgc_code = b.city_mun_psgc_code WHERE b.member_type = 'regular'
) AS o ORDER BY s, barangay_option

# Can planners trust it?

Summary first; the checks behind it follow.

frame.description: A measure has coverage below 90%, a missing value, or an outlier that flips the result.

frame.title: Outlier changed the result

frame.description: Every school year and school total present, so growth can count.

frame.title: Why LGUs are in Data Review
frame.description: An LGU can appear under more than one measure. An incomplete enrollment trend does not send the LGU to Data Review; it only stops growth from counting.

frame.title: Does an outlier flip the result?
frame.description: LGUs with flagged schools. Points in the off-diagonal quadrants cross the 1.00 line when the flagged schools are left out; D-058 sends those to Data Review.

frame.description: The AP2 reference is the pooled ratio for each type (see the table). The 45:1 line is context only: the room count includes labs and other rooms, so the statutory classroom-shortage rule does not apply.

frame.title: The references
frame.description: SUM(numerator) ÷ SUM(denominator) over LGUs with no input issue. Never an average of LGU ratios. Not narrowed by Region or Province.

frame.title: What if the stable band changed?
frame.description: D-058 counts growth above +5%, which the team and mentor have not yet confirmed. A narrower band moves LGUs into Priority 1 and 3; a wider one moves them out. The published priority always uses ±5%.

frame.title: Coverage by measure
frame.description: Below 90% the measure is not compared and the LGU is in Data Review.

## How the priority is decided

| Pressures above the reference | Enrollment growing (> +5%, trend complete) | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or 3 | **Priority 1** | **Priority 2** |
| 1 | **Priority 3** | Monitor |
| 0 | Monitor | Lower Priority |

Any pressure in Data Review makes the LGU **Data Review** first. Each pressure compares the LGU's ratio with the pooled ratio of LGUs of the same type. **D-058 is provisional:** the new AP1 and AP4 metrics, the ±5% band and the matrix await team and mentor confirmation.

**It can't tell you** how many schools, rooms or teachers to add; why an LGU is under pressure (poverty and the gap are context only); how far children travel; or whether a school's report is right (flagged schools are checked, never removed).
